preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() or c.isdigit() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string must contain only uppercase letters and digits.
The input string must not be empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout == sum(int(word, 16) for word in s.split() if all(c in '0123456789ABCDEF' for c in word))
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of valid hex words converted to decimal.
